title: profile.json user
description: The own columns of the person (one object): e-mail for display, language, time zone and last activity.

email.description: E-mail address for display; absent without one.

locale.description: Language of the person as a BCP 47 tag.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the person as an IANA name.

last_active_at.description: Last activity of the person; absent when never recorded.
